_comment: Scope for the SOX approver-matrix workbooks. Add/remove objects, change approvers or columns here. Deal Payment (Tier__c) is deprecated and intentionally absent.

objects.soql: SELECT Id, Name, Division__c, Office__c, Approver1__r.Name, Approver2__r.Name FROM Approver_Matrix__c WHERE Object_API_Name__c = 'Bill__c' ORDER BY Id
SELECT Id, Name, Division__c, Approver1__r.Name, Approver2__r.Name FROM Approver_Matrix__c WHERE Object_API_Name__c = 'Invoice__c' ORDER BY Id

SELECT Id, Dispute_Type__c, Division__c, Department__c, Team__c, Dispute_Amount__c, Approver1__c, Approver2__c, Approver3__c, Approver_4__c, Approver5__c FROM Approver_Matrix__c WHERE Object_API_Name__c = 'Dispute__c' ORDER BY Id LIMIT 700
objects.soql_note: Page with AND Id > '<last 18-char Id>'. Resolve approver Ids to names with SELECT Id, Name, IsActive FROM User WHERE Id IN (...).

objects.soql: SELECT Id, Name, Division__c, Sub_Division__c, Department__c, Office__c, Team__c, Team_for_Approval__c, Credit_Amount__c, Account_Manager__r.Name, Approver1__r.Name, Approver2__r.Name, Approver3__r.Name, Approver_4__r.Name FROM Approver_Matrix__c WHERE Object_API_Name__c = 'Credit_Check__c' ORDER BY Id
